name: Tasmanian apprentice travel and accommodation contribution
summary: Skills Tasmania contributes to travel and accommodation costs for Tasmanian apprentices and trainees who travel to training.
key: 41 cents per km road travel (21 km or more one way) and $55 per night accommodation ($100 interstate).
who: Apprentices and trainees on a training contract registered in Tasmania
how: Within Tasmania your RTO sends the claim to Skills Tasmania within four weeks of each training session.

source.label: Skills Tasmania: Travel and accommodation contribution

evidence.quote: The contributions are only available to apprentices and trainees who are on a training contract registered in Tasmania.
Road travel: 41 cents per km (must travel 21 kms or further one way).
Accommodation: $55.00 per night if the apprentice/trainee must travel 61 kms or more to training.
